items.title: A covering of the generic fibre by closed subsets spreads to a neighbourhood
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base, a covering of the generic fibre by finitely many closed subsets spreads to a covering of every fibre over a nonempty open, comparing each fibre with the closures of the given subsets. The proof takes the closures of the closed subsets in the total space, spreads them to a neighbourhood using finite type, and then checks that over a nonempty open their traces still cover each fibre. Keeping the covering property while spreading is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 6668-6683.
